decisions.reason: The charting bundle has a page of its own, was announced as a new map.apps bundle, and has been released four times in short succession, showing active investment and public commitment that management will want to justify.
The hierarchical search bundle is only mentioned and carries little visible commitment, but as a low-cost extension of the core map.apps platform it costs little to keep.
VueTOC was announced on the home page as a new approach for mobile map control, which creates public commitment, though as an experimental component it could later be folded into other offerings.
The GIS platform is the firm's flagship product line and central to its announced direction, so heavy investment and visible commitment make dropping it very unlikely.
The mobile field data capture software has a dedicated page and fits the firm's core offer, so any weak results can be attributed to temporary adoption delays.
The search extension has its own page and is closely tied to the firm's web map apps, so management will keep it as part of the committed platform ecosystem.
